description: Implementation of URLRequestThrottlerEntry class managing request throttling, backoff, and request timing logic in the net namespace.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerEntry
classes.description: Manages request throttling, backoff, and timing for individual URL requests within the net namespace.

methods.name: IsEntryOutdated
methods.description: Determines if the throttler entry is outdated and can be discarded.

methods.name: DisableBackoffThrottling
methods.description: Disables backoff throttling for this entry.

methods.name: DetachManager
methods.description: Detaches the throttler entry from its manager.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request should be rejected based on current backoff state.

methods.name: ReserveSendingTimeForNextRequest
methods.description: Reserves a sending time for the next request, considering throttling and sliding window.

methods.name: GetExponentialBackoffReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the release time after exponential backoff, or now if backoff is disabled.

methods.name: UpdateWithResponse
methods.description: Updates backoff state based on the response status code.

methods.name: ReceivedContentWasMalformed
methods.description: Handles malformed content responses, counting as failures.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes default parameters for the throttler entry.

methods.name: IsConsideredSuccess
methods.description: Determines if a response code is considered a success for backoff logic.

methods.name: ImplGetTimeNow
methods.description: Returns the current time in TimeTicks.
